request: Rename the `watched` field of watchlist items to `seen` everywhere.

requests.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
requests.reason: The test asserts `store.items()[0].watched` to verify the link click did not toggle the flag. `WatchItem` now carries `seen: boolean` instead of `watched: boolean`, so the assertion was updated to read `.seen`. The test's intent and behaviour are unchanged.

approvals.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
